display.purpose: The multicolour "Rewards" title only. Each letter has its own paint, a ±6deg tilt, a 3px white die-cut outline (eight hard white text-shadows) and a navy drop. 30px at ≤520px.

headline.purpose: "Reward time!" and "Good job, NAME!" on paper cards, with balanced wrap. The win-card prize name uses clamp(30px,4vw,52px)/1.04.

numeral.purpose: Tabular numerals beside the foil star. They scale with density: roomy clamp(54px,6vw,92px), tight clamp(28px,2.4vw,38px).

praise.purpose: Floating "Good job, NAME!" tags on a random paint.

title.purpose: The editor heading, in Bulletin Navy. The wheel's spin tag is clamp(22px,2.4vw,34px)/1.1.

section.purpose: Editor section heads, in Bulletin Navy.

button.purpose: All pill button labels. The big variant is clamp(22px,2vw,28px).

claim.purpose: "Claim reward" and "Spin!" on the gold pill.

lead.purpose: Card sentences in Faded Grape Ink, with the kid's name bold in Grape Ink.

name-tag.purpose: Kid names on white paper labels. They scale with density and ellipsise on one line.

field.purpose: Inputs and rule labels in the notebook drawer. 17px on phones.

body.purpose: Teacher-facing hints and the keyboard list. The sticky-note tip uses 700 at the same size, max 44ch.

label-sm.purpose: The "N more" label and kbd caps.

materials.name: fibers
materials.value: var(--fibers): two stacked SVG feTurbulence tiles (240px white fibres at baseFrequency .75, plus 200px dark specks at .9)
materials.purpose: The paper grain, layered over the sky ground, kid strips, rails, cards, the sticky note, tape, paint chips, the medal, the spin tag and praise. White labels and tools stay smooth.

materials.name: masking-tape
materials.value: 78x26px (58x20px tight), fibres over rgba(246,236,205,.9), 22-point jagged clip-path, rotated -7deg/6deg, top:-12px; on the Reward time card (.card.taped) 96x30px, 18px in, top:-24px, rotated -8deg/7deg
materials.purpose: Two pieces hold every kid strip and the Reward time card. A wider strip holds the wheel flapper.

materials.name: foil-sticker
materials.value: Ten-point star; 10px white round-join stroke (die-cut edge) under a 3px foil stroke and a diagonal foil gradient; white four-point glint on the left arm; face: two #231C45 oval eyes (.star-eyes, blinking) with white catchlights, #F0609E cheeks at .55, #231C45 smile
materials.purpose: Earned stars in rails, counts, prompts, sparks and the drawer preview. The star-button star wears the same face without catchlights.

materials.name: gift-sticker
materials.value: White paper disc, 1.75x the tag size, -7px overlap, lift-sm, fixed tilt; gift glyph at 68% cycling #DC3B26, #7A4CC2, #23874A, #F7801E, #2A5CD6, #F0609E with white knock-outs; at most 4 shown, then a "+N" Bagel sticker in ink
materials.purpose: Rewards won this lesson (kid.won), shown after the name label. Cleared by New lesson.

materials.name: crayon-outline
materials.value: The same star in two dashed strokes in the kid paint: 3.2px dash 6/4 at .75, plus 1.4px dash 10/5 at .4, offset .8px

materials.name: scallop-border
materials.value: Radial-gradient circles of 11.5px at a 24px pitch, in a six-paint sequence repeating every 144px; 14px band on all four edges, z 30

materials.name: notebook-paper
materials.value: White; 2px margin rule (#F2A0A8) at 52px (28px on phones); 2px rule (#CFE0F6) every 37px; background-attachment local

materials.name: paper-plate
materials.value: White disc r249; fluted rim r236 (22px stroke #E4E8F0, dash 3.4/4); crease rings #D9DFEA; slices r218 with 4px white seams under fibres at .7; centre r66 white; glass sheen radial overlay

materials.name: yarn-and-clips
materials.value: Yarn 4px repeating-linear-gradient(170deg,#E2475E 0 3px,#B8233A 3px 5px), 60svh tall at 22%/78%; clips 18x34px, 4px radius, linear-gradient(90deg,#F0609E,#D9428A)

materials.name: cut-paper-scene
materials.value: Sun (rays #FFB21A turning 60s; face #FFD43B with white rim, ink eyes, orange cheeks at .45), three white clouds, six-band paint rainbow, hills #6BCB5E/#3FA34D with flower dots, four foil sparks, two squiggles (white, gold-hi)
materials.purpose: Fixed decoration only: aria-hidden and pointer-events none.

shadows.name: lift-sm
shadows.purpose: Labels and small stickers: tools, name tags, count chips, the N-more label, add-kid, the tip, undo and stepper discs.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Strips, the star button, the claim pill, paper buttons, the spin tag, praise and the medal.

shadows.name: press
shadows.purpose: The active state of tools. The star button drops to lift-sm instead.

shadows.name: die-cut-ring
shadows.purpose: The white sticker edge on raised pieces over colour: claim pill, paper buttons, spin tag, praise.

shadows.name: medal-ring
shadows.purpose: The prize medal on the win card.

shadows.name: card-frame
shadows.purpose: Claim prompt and win cards, framed in the kid's paper.

shadows.name: hub
shadows.purpose: The SPIN hub collar, in container units so it scales with the plate.

shadows.name: sticker-drop
shadows.purpose: The one warm shadow, under foil stars in the rail.

shadows.name: scene-drop
shadows.value: filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 6px rgba(12,32,90,.18)) clouds; drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgba(12,32,90,.3)) border; drop-shadow(0 4px 4px rgba(12,24,70,.4)) flapper
shadows.purpose: Cut-paper scene pieces lifting off the board.

shadows.name: recess
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(35,28,69,.06) (rail); inset 0 2px 3px rgba(35,28,69,.12) (field); inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(35,28,69,.15) (kbd)

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Dims the board like room lights going down.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Every focusable element. Switch tracks and the current choice in a picker use the same ring.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: An overshoot spring for anything that sticks on, appears or is pressed.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Slides and drifts: the drawer and praise.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Hover lift (-2px, -1.5deg tilt) and press (1px down, .93-.97 scale) on stickers and buttons.

motion.name: star-drop
motion.value: .55s pop; from translateY(-80%) scale(1.6) rotate(-40deg), overshoot +4deg, settle at the slot tilt
motion.purpose: A star sticks on.

motion.name: count-bump
motion.purpose: The star count changes.

motion.name: star-hop
motion.value: .62s pop, staggered 70ms per star; up 38%, rotate 20deg, scale 1.18
motion.purpose: A strip completes. The prompt follows 950ms later (250ms under reduced motion).

motion.name: star-blink
motion.purpose: Every foil face blinks together.

motion.name: claim-pop
motion.purpose: A claim pill arrives.

motion.name: gift-in
motion.value: .7s pop; from scale(0) rotate(-90deg) to the sticker's tilt
motion.purpose: A newly won gift sticker joins the name row when the wheel lands.

motion.name: wheel-won
motion.value: .wheel-stage.won: plate card to opacity 0, scale(.8) translateY(40px), .5s ease-out (opacity .35s); close tool hidden
motion.purpose: The plate sinks away so the win card hangs alone. Spin again clears it.

motion.name: toolbar-hide
motion.purpose: Top-bar tools hide while the wheel is open.

motion.name: claim-wiggle
motion.purpose: A waiting reward. Paused on hover.

motion.name: need-nudge
motion.purpose: A claim tried too early, with a bonk sound.

motion.name: card-in
motion.value: .7s pop; from scale(.2) rotate(-14deg) to rotate(-1deg)
motion.purpose: The claim prompt and win card arrive.

motion.name: wheel-in
motion.value: .6s pop; from scale(.3) rotate(-25deg); scrim fades .4s; exit holds visibility for .5s
motion.purpose: The paper plate comes out.

motion.name: hub-breathe
motion.purpose: A spin is ready.

motion.name: spin
motion.value: 6000-6600ms, eased 1-(1-t)^3.4, six turns; lands 16-84% across the winning slice; reduced motion: one turn, 1600ms
motion.purpose: The prize spin.

motion.name: flapper-kick
motion.value: Each peg crossing sets the flap to -(9 + v*26)deg, clamped 9-30deg, decaying x0.8 per frame; plays a tick whose volume follows speed (.14-.42)
motion.purpose: The paper flapper ticking past pegs.

motion.name: win-pulse
motion.purpose: The winning slice. The win card follows 1100ms later (100ms under reduced motion).

motion.name: praise
motion.value: 1.4s ease-out; scale .2 to 1.15 to 1 to .94 while rising from -60% to -165% and fading
motion.purpose: "Good job, NAME!"

motion.name: confetti-burst
motion.value: Canvas; star/dot/chip/strip pieces in 10 paints + gold x2 + white; gravity .16, terminal 6.5, flutter; 170 (win), 140 (prompt), 90 (win card)
motion.purpose: Falls from the top on big moments.

motion.name: confetti-pop
motion.value: Upward cone from the new sticker; 34 pieces (60 on completion), life 140 frames
motion.purpose: Each star awarded.

motion.name: drawer-slide
motion.purpose: The notebook drawer opening and closing.

motion.name: switch-thumb
motion.purpose: Toggle switches.

motion.name: title-flip
motion.value: .3s pop; each letter mirrors its tilt and rises 3px on hover
motion.purpose: Title play.

motion.name: sun-spin
motion.purpose: The only ambient motion on the board.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: All animations and transitions .01ms, single iteration; sun, wiggle, breathe and blink off; praise uses praiseStill (1.6s linear: fade in, hold in place, fade out); confetti becomes still pieces that fade over 70 frames (burst up to 70, per-star 18 around the sticker); spin one turn over 1.6s
motion.purpose: Respects prefers-reduced-motion. Results stay visible and announced.

sound.name: engine
sound.value: Web Audio, synthesised; DynamicsCompressor (threshold -14dB, ratio 4); master gain .7
sound.purpose: Mutable from the sound tool and the drawer switch.

sound.name: marimba
sound.purpose: The base voice for every note.

sound.name: pop
sound.purpose: A star sticking on; a spin starting.

sound.name: star
sound.value: Pop + marimba on a pentatonic ladder indexed by slot: C5 D5 E5 G5 A5 C6 D6 E6 G6 A6

sound.name: earned
sound.value: Arpeggio C5 E5 G5 C6 E6 G6, 80ms apart

sound.name: bonk
sound.purpose: Too early, or the hub is disabled.

sound.name: win
sound.value: G5 C6 E6 G6 E6 G6 C7 over a C5/E5 chord

sound.name: sound-on
sound.purpose: Confirms that sound is switched on.

breakpoints.name: lanes-xs
breakpoints.purpose: Every density uses the three-row stack, with stars in cqi units.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: 30px title, 46px tools, the drawer margin moves to 28px.

breakpoints.name: lanes-sm
breakpoints.purpose: Roomy strips restack to three rows.

breakpoints.name: lanes-sm-tight
breakpoints.purpose: Tight strips return to two rows.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: One-screen board (100svh), density auto-fit, wheel peek beside the editor. Below this, tool labels hide and the scene is trimmed.

density.name: roomy
density.value: 1-2 kids; star clamp(64px,15vh,128px), button clamp(80px,12vh,108px), count clamp(54px,6vw,92px), tag clamp(22px,2.2vw,34px), padding 24px 28px

density.name: compact
density.value: 3-4 kids; star clamp(44px,7.4vh,66px), button clamp(56px,7.6vh,68px), count clamp(34px,3vw,48px), tag clamp(18px,1.5vw,23px), padding 16px 20px; areas "tag count actions" / "rail rail claim"

density.name: tight
density.value: 5-8 kids; star clamp(40px,5.8vh,60px), button clamp(52px,6.8vh,64px), count clamp(28px,2.4vw,38px), tag clamp(16px,1.3vw,20px), padding 12px 16px; one row "tag rail claim count actions"

density.name: stage
density.purpose: Board padding around the strip column.

components.name: Sticker Tool
components.description: A white paper pill in the top bar. It tilts and lifts on hover, and collapses to a 52px icon disc below 900px.

components.name: Claim Pill
components.description: A waiting reward: a gold foil pill with a die-cut paper ring and an idle wiggle. A red badge counts extra rewards.

components.css: .ds-card::before,.ds-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:-24px;width:96px;height:30px;background:rgba(246,236,205,.9);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.15);clip-path:polygon(0 12%,6% 0,12% 10%,20% 2%,30% 9%,42% 1%,55% 8%,66% 0,78% 9%,88% 1%,100% 10%,97% 50%,100% 90%,90% 100%,78% 92%,64% 100%,52% 91%,40% 100%,28% 92%,16% 100%,5% 92%,2% 50%)}.ds-card::before{left:18px;transform:rotate(-8deg)}.ds-card::after{right:18px;transform:rotate(7deg)}.ds-card{position:relative;max-width:480px;margin:0 auto;padding:30px 32px 26px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink,#231C45);background-color:#FFFFFF;background-image:var(--fibers,none);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 0 0 12px var(--frame),0 0 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,.08),0 26px 44px rgba(12,24,70,.5);transform:rotate(-1deg);animation:ds-card-in .7s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) both}.ds-card-h{margin:0;font:400 48px/1.02 var(--display,'Bagel Fat One','Arial Rounded MT Bold',sans-serif)}.ds-card-lead{margin:10px 0 0;font:700 20px/1.35 var(--text,'Andika','Century Gothic',sans-serif);color:var(--ink-soft,#4B4570)}.ds-card-lead b{color:var(--ink,#231C45)}.ds-card-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:14px;margin-top:20px}.ds-card-gold,.ds-card-plain{min-height:58px;padding:0 26px 2px;border:0;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;font:400 21px/1 var(--display,'Bagel Fat One',sans-serif)}.ds-card-gold{color:#3A2200;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 25%,#FFE27A,#FFC21A 55%);box-shadow:0 2px 3px rgba(12,32,90,.22),0 10px 18px rgba(12,32,90,.28)}.ds-card-plain{color:#231C45;background:#F2F6FC;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(12,32,90,.25),0 5px 9px rgba(12,32,90,.25)}.ds-card-gold:focus-visible,.ds-card-plain:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #231C45;outline-offset:3px}@keyframes ds-card-in{from{transform:scale(.2) rotate(-14deg);opacity:0}to{transform:rotate(-1deg);opacity:1}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-card{animation:none}}

components.name: Notebook Field Row
components.description: An editor row on notebook paper: a paint chip, a recessed cool-paper name field and a trash button.

components.name: Praise Tag
components.description: "Good job, NAME!" on a random construction paper (never the last paint, never the kid's own), with a paper ring, popping up and floating away.
components.css: .ds-praise{display:inline-block;padding:.3em .7em .38em;border-radius:12px;font:400 40px/1 var(--display,'Bagel Fat One','Arial Rounded MT Bold',sans-serif);color:var(--t);white-space:nowrap;background-color:var(--c);background-image:var(--fibers,none);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #FFFFFF,var(--lift,0 2px 3px rgba(12,32,90,.22),0 10px 18px rgba(12,32,90,.28));transform:rotate(var(--r));animation:ds-praise 1.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) infinite}@keyframes ds-praise{0%{transform:translateY(20px) scale(.2) rotate(var(--r));opacity:0}16%{transform:translateY(-10px) scale(1.15) rotate(var(--r));opacity:1}72%{transform:translateY(-20px) scale(1) rotate(var(--r));opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(-44px) scale(.94) rotate(var(--r));opacity:0}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-praise{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Rewards is a bulletin board a teacher made by hand. The ground is a sheet of sky-blue construction paper inside a scalloped rainbow border; a cut-paper sun, clouds, a rainbow and two hills sit around the edges. Each kid gets a strip of construction paper in their own colour, held on with two pieces of masking tape. Their name is on a white paper label. Each answer sticks a smiling gold foil star into one of the crayon outlines on that strip. When the strip is full, a paper card taped to the board says "Reward time!". Only then does the paper-plate spinner come out. The prize lands on a card that hangs alone on red yarn with pink clips, and a round gift sticker joins the kid's name label. Everything is something a child could find in a classroom craft drawer, and every surface carries a faint paper-fibre grain.

The world is loud in colour and quiet in structure. There are ten saturated construction-paper paints, and each comes as a set of three: the paper, its shade and a label ink. Gold foil is the one precious material, and it is only spent on stars and on the reward path. Text never floats on colour. It sits on white paper labels, or it is set in the paint's own label ink. Pieces are placed by hand: strips, tags, cards and chips each lean a degree or two, and the tape leans further. Depth is real lift, with soft navy shadows as if daylight were falling on blue paper. Motion is springy and sticky (things stick on, pop, wiggle and hop), and every celebration is also a sound.

The thesis refuses two things, and so does this file: the pastel-gradient kids app, and the carnival wheel that is always on screen. The board at rest is stars and strips only. The wheel only appears once a reward is claimed, or as a live preview beside the editor on desktop.
keyCharacteristics: A sky construction-paper ground with fibre grain, a 14px rainbow scalloped border, and a cut-paper scene that is decoration only.
Kid strips in saturated paint colours, each taped on with masking tape and tilted ±0.5deg.
Gold foil sticker stars with a die-cut white edge and a blinking face, placed into crayon-dashed outlines.
Rewards won are kept as round white gift stickers beside the kid's name.
White paper labels for all text that sits at rest; paint label ink for text on colour.
Bagel Fat One cut-out letters for shouted moments; Andika literacy text for everything that is read or edited.
Two-step navy lift, die-cut paper rings on raised stickers, and an overshoot "pop" spring.
A paper-plate wheel with a fluted rim and a taped paper flapper that ticks on every peg.
Marimba, pop and tick sounds synthesised live, with mute in two places; reduced motion keeps every result readable.

rules.name: The Foil Is Earned Rule
rules.body: The foil gradient and the gold radial pill belong only to stars and the reward path: sticker stars, the star count, the star button's star, the claim pill, Claim reward, Spin again and the SPIN hub. Yellow paper (paint-yellow) is a different material. It is flat and has no radial highlight.

rules.name: The Paper Label Rule
rules.body: Text never sits bare on construction paper. On a kid strip, the name, count and "N more" label each sit on white paper. When text has to sit on paint (the spin tag, praise, wheel slice labels, prize pictures), it is set in that paint's own label ink.

rules.name: The Paint Set Rule
rules.body: A paint is always used as its full set: paper, shade and label ink. Never pair one paint's paper with another paint's ink.

rules.name: The Cut-Out Letter Rule
rules.body: Bagel Fat One is only used for short shouted words: the title, card headings, praise, numerals, button labels, the spin tag and SPIN. It is a single weight (400). Never set a sentence in it.

rules.name: The Literacy Text Rule
rules.body: Anything read or edited at rest is Andika: name tags, slice labels, fields, leads, hints and tips. It uses 700 for anything a child reads and 400 only for teacher-facing hints.

rules.name: The One-Board Rule
rules.body: On desktop the whole lesson fits on one screen. Density steps from roomy to compact to tight before anything is allowed to scroll.

rules.name: The Scene Stays Back Rule
rules.body: The sun, clouds, rainbow, hills, sparks and squiggles are fixed, aria-hidden and pointer-transparent, and they are trimmed away before content ever shrinks.

rules.name: The Navy Daylight Rule
rules.body: Lift shadows are always navy-tinted (rgba(12,32,90,…) or rgba(12,24,70,…)). Neutral black only appears in hairline rings and tape edges.

rules.name: The Die-Cut Ring Rule
rules.body: Any sticker raised on colour gets a white paper ring before its lift. That ring is what makes it read as cut out, not printed.

dos: Do set text at rest on white paper. On paint, use only that paint's label ink (paint-*-label).
Do give every sticker raised on colour a die-cut paper ring: 4px Paper White then Lift; 8px on the medal; 3px on chips.
Do place paper by hand. Content pieces lean between −2deg and 2deg (strips ±0.5deg alternating, tags −2deg, count chips 1.5deg, cards −1deg). Tape may lean up to ±7deg and decoration up to ±22deg.
Do use the crayon dashed outline for "not yet": empty star slots in the kid's paint, and dashed borders on add tiles and drop targets.
Do spring things that stick on or appear with the pop curve (cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)), and slide drawers and drifting pieces with ease-out (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)).
Do lay the fibre texture over every construction-paper, sticky-note, card, rail, tape, paint-chip and medal surface. White labels and tools stay smooth.
Do pair every state with a picture and a number (foil star plus count, gift plus "N more", prize picture plus name), so it reads without reading.
Do pair every celebration with sound and confetti, and make sure the result still reads when both are off.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more (tools 52px, star button 52–108px, undo 46px, chips 44 and 52px).
donts: Don't put the wheel on the board at rest. It only comes out to claim a reward, or as the desktop peek beside the editor.
Don't use pastel gradients or decorative UI gradients. A gradient here only renders a material: foil, the gold pill and hub, yarn twist, plastic clips, ruled lines, scallops or the plate sheen.
Don't spend gold foil outside the earned path, and don't give yellow paper a foil highlight.
Don't cast lift shadows in neutral black. Lift is navy.
Don't set sentences, at-rest names or form text in Bagel Fat One, and don't set headings, numerals or button labels in Andika.
Don't set white text on Poster Red (4.47:1) or Construction-Paper Sky (4.0:1) below Bagel button size. Use the fold shade or Grape Ink instead.
Don't let decoration compete with strips. The scene stays fixed and pointer-transparent, and it is trimmed on small screens before content shrinks.
